links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified English and Spanish pediatric orthopaedic patient education materials (baseline readability)
links.outcome: Proportion of articles at or below sixth-grade reading level (FKGL), plus GFI, SMOG, FRE and FHI scores
links.effect: Baseline ≤sixth FKGL was 5.8% for English and 10.0% for Spanish articles. After conversion, English reached 21.4% (ChatGPT-4.0) and 60.2% (Google Gemini). Spanish reached 52.5% (ChatGPT-4.0) and 77.5% (Google Gemini). Gemini outperformed ChatGPT-4.0 on GFI, English FKGL and Spanish SMOG (all P < 0.05).
links.tradeoff: Improvement was only moderate: many converted articles still missed the sixth-grade target, especially English articles converted by ChatGPT-4.0. The abstract does not report content accuracy or completeness after simplification.
links.quote: 21.4% and 60.2% of ChatGPT-4.0-converted and Google Gemini-converted English PEMs achieved ≤sixth FKGL, respectively.

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompting for LLM rewriting of patient education materials
